decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm opponents with evasive creatures such as Ninja of the Deep Hours and Faerie Seer, while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and Spellstutter Sprite. Moon-Circuit Hacker and Of One Mind provide card advantage, while Cryoshatter helps to clear the way for attacks. Sewer-veillance Cam serves as a versatile utility card, and Faerie Miscreant and Brinebarrow Intruder round out the aggressive strategy. The deck aims to maintain pressure and tempo while controlling the board to secure victory.

This deck focuses on dealing direct damage to the opponent quickly and efficiently, using a combination of burn spells and aggressive creatures. The goal is to apply pressure to the opponent from the start and finish them off before they can stabilize. With a low mana curve and an emphasis on cheap spells, the deck aims to consistently deal damage every turn and close out the game before the opponent has a chance to mount a strong defense.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using a combination of low-cost burn spells and aggressive creatures. By efficiently using cards like Lightning Bolt and Fiery Temper, along with creature abilities like Guttersnipe and Kessig Flamebreather, the deck aims to reduce the opponent's life total as quickly as possible. Additionally, cards like Grab the Prize and Highway Robbery provide extra utility and potential card advantage to keep the pressure on the opponent. Overall, this deck is designed to be fast and relentless in its pursuit of victory.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using cheap spells and creatures, while also utilizing cards that allow for card draw and additional damage. With a focus on burning the opponent with cards like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast, as well as utilizing cards like Guttersnipe and Kessig Flamebreather to amplify damage output. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced aggressive strategy that focuses on burning the opponent down before they can establish a strong defense.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Arbor Elf to cast powerful creatures and spells ahead of schedule. The deck includes a mix of aggressive creatures like Avenging Hunter and Boarding Party, along with disruptive spells like Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Thermokarst to slow down opponents. Eldrazi Repurposer helps generate additional value, while cards like Writhing Chrysalis provide additional threats. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient creatures and disrupt their game plan with land destruction and ramp strategies.

The focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with low-cost creatures and disruptive spells, particularly focusing on Faeries. By using cheap creatures and counterspells, the deck aims to maintain control of the board while continuously applying pressure to the opponent. The inclusion of card draw spells and evasive creatures allows for consistent card advantage and chip damage, ultimately leading to victory through tempo and aggression.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with the Urzatron lands and Expedition Map, allowing for powerful late-game plays. It utilizes control elements like Crop Rotation and Unfathomable Truths to disrupt opponents while generating advantage with cards like Ancient Stirrings and Pulse of Murasa. The win condition revolves around Nyxborn Hydra, Writhing Chrysalis, and Bramble Wurm, with Malevolent Rumble providing additional removal. Bonder's Ornament and Giant's Boulder provide card draw and utility, creating a versatile and resilient control deck with a strong late-game presence.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game and ramp up quickly by assembling the Urzatron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, Tower) to generate a lot of mana. Utilizing powerful creatures like Boulderbranch Golem, Bramble Wurm, Maelstrom Colossus, and Pinnacle Kill-Ship, along with support cards like Candy Trail and Expedition Map, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats while disrupting their strategy with control elements like Crop Rotation, Unfathomable Truths, and Generous Ent. The deck also includes card draw and mana fixing to ensure consistency in executing its game plan.

The main idea of this Aura Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up with Utopia Sprawl and Gladecover Scout, then overwhelm the opponent with powerful auras like Ethereal Armor and Ancestral Mask to create a large, unstoppable threat. Malevolent Rumble and Rancor provide additional damage and resilience, while Armadillo Cloak and Lifelink help to maintain a strong life total. The deck aims to outpace the opponent and close out the game quickly, utilizing a combination of evasion, power boosts, and life gain to secure victory.

The deck focuses on using the combo of Balustrade Spy and Dread Return to mill the entire library, allowing for a quick win condition by bringing out Lotleth Giant to deal damage equal to the number of creatures milled. The deck is built around ramping up mana with creatures like Overgrown Battlement and Saruli Caretaker to quickly get the necessary pieces on the battlefield. Lead the Stampede and Winding Way help to find the combo pieces efficiently, while also providing card advantage. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and win the game before the opponent can respond.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through removal spells and powerful creatures like Crypt Rats. It also utilizes sacrifice effects like Fanatical Offering and Tithing Blade to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck includes ways to disrupt graveyard strategies with Nihil Spellbomb and Bojuka Bog. The use of token generators like Khalni Garden and Ichor Wellspring helps to maintain board presence while keeping the opponent in check. Overall, the goal is to outvalue the opponent and grind out a win through attrition.

The main theme of this deck is to utilize artifacts and affinity to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures and efficient spells. By using cards like Thoughtcast and Myr Enforcer to benefit from the high artifact count, as well as burn spells like Galvanic Blast to remove blockers or finish off opponents, this deck aims to maintain a fast pace and apply pressure early on. Additionally, cards like Drossforge Bridge and Mistvault Bridge help provide additional benefits for playing artifacts, further enhancing the deck's strategy.

This Dimir Control deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy through counterspells and removal spells, while also fueling its graveyard with cards like Mental Note and Thought Scour. The deck utilizes cards like Tolarian Terror and Murmuring Mystic to generate tokens for defense and pressure. The control aspect is further enhanced by cards like Dispel and Spell Pierce to protect against opposing spells. The deck's key strategy is to maintain control of the game through efficient removal and counterspells, ultimately leading to victory through attrition and card advantage.

The main focus of this Mono Blue Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with low-cost creatures and spells while utilizing card draw and disruption to maintain pressure. The deck aims to control the board through counterspells and removal, while also utilizing card filtering effects like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure a consistent stream of threats. By efficiently utilizing card advantage and tempo plays, this deck looks to establish an early advantage and secure a quick victory through a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy by using a combination of removal spells and defensive creatures. The Gates archetype provides additional mana fixing and card advantage, allowing for powerful plays in the mid to late game. With a mix of removal, protection, and card draw, this deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through incremental advantage. Additionally, the inclusion of creatures with evasion helps to close out the game quickly once control has been established.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Arbor Elf, and disrupting opponents' lands with Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Thermokarst. It then plays a variety of high-power creatures like Boarding Party and Annoyed Altisaur to quickly close out the game. The deck also includes some card draw and mana fixing with Bonder's Ornament and Wild Growth. Malevolent Rumble and Writhing Chrysalis provide additional removal and disruption, while Avenging Hunter serves as a strong finisher.
